name: liquid-agent
description: A private AI agent for macOS and Linux that runs LFM3 1.7B and LFM3 Omni 2B locally, with a web UI. The server is Rust.

scripts.start: npm run build && cargo run --release -p liquid-server -- --open
scripts.dev: vite build --watch --mode development & cargo run -p liquid-server
scripts.test: cargo build -p liquid-server -p liquid-guardian && node scripts/smoke.mjs
